main.description: A record of a harvest minigame round played by a user

earlyHarvests.description: Number of shapes harvested early (during growth phase)

efficiencyBonus.description: Bonus points awarded for harvest efficiency (percentage of shapes collected)

finalScore.description: Final score achieved in the round

gameContext.description: Where the game was played: dedicated minigame page or harvest loading screen

lateHarvests.description: Number of shapes harvested late (during decay phase)

peakHarvestRate.description: Percentage indicating how close on average the user harvested at peak timing (scaled by 100, so 9550 = 95.50%)

peakRateBonus.description: Bonus points awarded for achieving high peak harvest rate

perfectHarvests.description: Number of shapes harvested at perfect (peak) timing

playedAt.description: When the game round was played (ISO 8601)

pointsPerSecond.description: Average rate of points scored per second (scaled by 100, so 123 = 1.23 points/second)

roundDuration.description: Duration of the round in seconds

shapesMissed.description: Total number of shapes that expired without being harvested

totalShapesSpawned.description: Total number of shapes spawned during the round (collected + missed)

rarityBreakdown.description: Count of each rarity level collected

veryCommon.description: Number of very common (circle) shapes collected

veryRare.description: Number of very rare (sparkle) shapes collected
